# Matthew Thaokhamlue - Senior AI Product Manager

> Matthew Thaokhamlue is a Senior AI Product Manager based in Berlin, Germany, with 7+ years of experience driving AI-powered innovation in health analytics, laboratory informatics, and B2B SaaS platforms. He specializes in AI/ML product development, API/SDK platforms, voice AI, and cross-functional team leadership.

## Professional Summary

Senior Product Manager with 7+ years of experience building and scaling B2B SaaS products at the intersection of AI, health analytics, and laboratory informatics. Proven track record of taking products from 0 to 1M+ users, driving revenue growth from €0 to €1M ARR, and leading cross-functional teams across engineering, design, data, and customer success. Deep technical fluency across cloud architectures (AWS, Azure), AI/ML systems, API platforms, and voice AI. Known for bridging technical complexity with human-centered design, rapid prototyping, and data-driven decision making. Now also governs daily AI/LLM cost for a production platform, turning runaway model spend into a managed, ROI-positive line item. Runs his own PM practice through a personal multi-agent AI operating system he built: agents that work like colleagues across web, Slack, and Teams, with human review on everything that ships.

## Work Experience

### Senior AI Product Manager — Sema Technologies Inc.
**Mar 2026 - Present | Dresden & Berlin, Germany**


Product manager for Liz, Sema’s AI agent connecting company priorities to work and shipped code. Answers cite sources; actions require human approval. Own delivery across two squads: Integrations, then Chat and Agent UX.

- Cut inefficient daily AI spend **~39% (~$3,250/month)** through usage-based auto-scaling, with no loss of customer coverage. Built and own the daily AI cost dashboard. Its first invoice reconciliation matched provider billing **within 0.26%**.
- Removed a recurring enterprise deal blocker with an AI-assisted release-note process that met **SOC 2** requirements. A named person approves each note before manual publication.
- Led Liz’s expansion from read-only analytics to **governed actions** across Slack, email, Confluence, Jira, and Linear. Led the build of customer-specific approval rules and maintain them.
- Owned the **integration roadmap through production rollout** across Jira, GitHub, Slack, Zoom, Linear, and document sources.
- Led **Chat and Agent UX** releases covering a shared document library, role-based access with tier gating, shared calculations, and customer-facing AI-spend limits. Delivered Microsoft Teams at Slack parity.

**How I work**

- With engineering: I turn customer problems into specifications and use AI tools to ship small front-end changes. Engineering can focus on backend logic.
- With customers: I work with Customer Success and professional services to identify needs across accounts. I decide what to configure, what to build for reuse, and what to decline.
- Key skills: AI Cost Governance, Integrations, Governed Agent Actions, SOC 2 Release Notes, Chat and Agent UX

### Labforward GmbH (incl. LabTwin, acquired)
**Jan 2023 - Nov 2025 | Berlin, Germany**

Joined LabTwin as Technical Product Manager for its voice-AI lab assistant. Then owned Labforward's core lab-operations products through and after the acquisition. Owned the roadmap, delivery, and customer-critical accounts across both products.

**How I work**

- With engineering: I used rapid prototypes to validate product ideas. I coordinated releases with engineering and co-led speech-recognition retraining with data scientists.
- With customers: I worked with scientists and enterprise customers on lab workflows and integrations. I aligned Product, Engineering, and customer teams on deliverables, timelines, and SLAs.

#### Senior Product Manager — Labforward
**Nov 2024 - Nov 2025**

Electronic lab notebook and lab-operations software that helps R&D scientists record, standardize, and run experiments.

- Rebuilt team collaboration and customer engagement loops, directly contributing to a $500K enterprise contract renewal. Coordinated Product, Engineering, and customer teams for the at-risk account.
- Introduced rapid prototyping cycles, reducing validation time from days to hours and accelerating customer feedback into the roadmap.
- Owned BI automation of internal reporting and data pipelines. Automated reports replaced ad-hoc requests and became a daily leadership decision input.
- Key skills: Enterprise Accounts, Rapid Prototyping, BI Automation

#### Technical Product Manager — LabTwin
**Jan 2023 - Nov 2024**

The world's first voice-powered AI lab assistant, letting scientists capture data and pull up information hands-free at the bench.

- Led the migration of intent recognition to GPT-3.5 in 2023. Shipped LLM-powered understanding into a production voice pipeline for pharma and biotech customers.
- Tripled deployment frequency from 4 to 12 production releases per year by streamlining release coordination with engineering.
- Drove speech recognition to 95% scientific-term accuracy for key customers. Co-led retraining with Azure custom speech training, using customer-specific glossaries and real voice data. Designed the training strategy to cut its cost.
- Drove an SAP integration workstream to a customer pilot. The pilot tested transferring LabTwin-captured lab data into the customer's SAP environment via the SAP API.
- Mentored a junior PM to full independence; they went on to own their own product area.
- Key skills: Voice AI, LLM in Production, Integrations, Release Coordination

### Product Owner — Thryve GmbH
**Oct 2019 - Dec 2022 | Berlin, Germany**

- Owned and scaled APIs and SDKs powering 1M+ users across 100+ B2B partners in digital health.
- Led 10+ wearable integrations (Fitbit, Garmin, Withings, Oura, Apple Health, and more).
- Contributed to company growth from €0 → €1M ARR and from 7 → 35 people.

## Personal Projects

### Opportunity Paths (opppaths.com) — Founder & Builder
**Jan 2026 - Present**

- AI-powered scholarship platform that matches students to funding and helps them build winning applications: profile-to-scholarship matching, gap analysis, document drafting, and interview preparation, localized in English and Thai.
- Built as the sole human owner through a personal multi-agent AI workflow of his own design; roughly 396 commits in the first six months, live in production configuration with an early-access waitlist.
- Built the eval harness that gates every model change: each candidate does the same jobs as production, an AI judge compares the six riskiest, and each candidate's own price is counted. It chose the model now shipping - 24 comparisons, no losses, 11.3x cheaper, faster on every job.
- Built a second eval for the step that reads scholarship pages, which was inventing dates. Twelve hand-checked pages showed a bigger model was no better - both invented a date 17% of the time - so a two-sentence prompt fix, not a costlier model, took it to zero. Those checks now guard the live data.
- Inspired by the DAAD scholarship that changed his own path in 2018; aimed first at students in the Mekong region.

### Remarcable Living (remarcableliving.co) — Design and build
**Sep 2026**

- Bangkok condo-rental website for exchange students and interns: pick a neighbourhood first, then the home, with dedicated pages for residences, neighbourhoods, student housing, about, and contact.
- Took over a half-finished build that was broken in production (dead navigation, a 404ing student-housing link, missing-media errors, homepage-anchor menus, a hero that spilled its frame on tablets) and turned it into a production-grade site: real routes, a build-time media manifest with honest fallbacks, full-page navigation, tablet fixes, a branded 404, sitemap and robots rules.
- Designed and shipped a scroll-driven cinematic hero that hands off into the live residence collection, plus a design-token system with shared navigation and footer; every change shipped with a rendered-HTML test run and headless-browser QA evidence, driven through his Claude Code workflow.

## About

Matthew's background spans economics, technology, and product management. He started with a degree in Economics from Chiang Mai University in Thailand, then received a DAAD scholarship to study International and Development Economics at HTW Berlin. His career journey took him from risk consulting at Ernst & Young in Bangkok to building digital health products at Thryve (employee #7), leading voice AI products at LabTwin, and continuing product ownership after LabTwin was acquired by Labforward, where he managed lab management platforms.

He is known for bridging technical complexity with human needs, having helped scale products from a few thousand users to over 1 million, and growing companies from €0 to €1M ARR. His approach focuses on user-centric design, rapid iteration, and data-informed decision making.
